name: Research Writing, Communication and Ethics in Design
description: Students will identify a research problem aligned with their Ph.D. research and conduct a systematic literature review. This process will include generating relevant keywords, identifying appropriate academic databases and information sources, screening the literature through title, abstract, and full-text review stages, and critically analyzing and synthesizing the selected studies to establish the current state of knowledge, identify research gaps, and refine the research problem.
